findings.title: COMPANY table constraints not verified
findings.description: The nullability, type, default, and constraint behavior of the five target columns (COMPANY_NAME, COMPANY_STATE, COMPANY_CITY, EMPLOYEE, COMPANY_CREATE_YEAR) was not confirmed because this static-review-only insert statement made no Database MCP call.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the COMPANY DDL (NOT NULL, defaults, unique constraints, column types) matches the five bound parameters before production use.

findings.title: NULL binding for non-nullable columns possible
findings.description: With parameterType=java.util.Map, an absent key binds NULL; if any of the five target columns is NOT NULL, the insert fails at runtime. Unverified against schema.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit presence checks for the required map keys (companyName, companyState, companyCity, employee, companyCreateYear) before invoking the mapper.

findings.title: Generated-key retrieval depends on driver support
findings.description: useGeneratedKeys=true with keyProperty=id and keyColumn=ID relies on the JDBC driver and engine supporting getGeneratedKeys; this behavior is unverified for the target environment.
findings.recommendation: Verify driver support for the target engine; if unreliable, use an explicit RETURNING/OUTPUT strategy and bind the generated id directly.
